name: Soledad Trujillo-Esquivel
location: The Underworld - B11, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description: Soledad Trujillo-Esquivel the Congregation organized around the Breathing. They hear the 11-minute pressure cycle from any level above B15.

physical_description.heritage: Multi-continental blend dominated by Hispanic/Latin American (36.9%) and Northern European (31.6%) ancestry, with substantial Sub-Saharan African (18.9%) admixture and smaller East Asian (5.7%), Southeast Asian (4.1%), and North African (2.8%) components. This creates a striking fusion: warm golden-brown skin with golden and reddish undertones reflecting the Latin American-European-African base, angular facial structure from Northern European and North African heritage blended with broader cheekbones from Sub-Saharan African ancestry, and subtle eye shape variations from East and Southeast Asian ancestry. The overall effect is a characteristic Ubiquitous Diaspora face — no single heritage dominant, but all visible in the harmonious layering of bone structure, skin tone, and subtle features.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, with long limbs suggesting years of navigating tight passages and vertical shafts. Chest slightly expanded from deep-breathing practice.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with threads of silver
physical_description.hair_style: Loose braids wrapped in worn linen cord, some adorned with small brass bells that chime softly when the wearer tilts their head
physical_description.eye_color: Deep dark brown with a distant, listening quality
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep brown with golden and subtle reddish undertones, darkened by sub-level dust exposure into a rich ashy patina
physical_description.complexion: Angular meditative face with high, prominent cheekbones reflecting the blend of Northern European, Sub-Saharan African, and Hispanic/Latin American ancestry. Facial structure shows the harmonious fusion of broader, sculpted cheekbones with angular jaw definition. Eyes set with slight epicanthic variation from East and Southeast Asian ancestry. Skin shows fine etching around the eyes and mouth from years of concentration. Minimal grooming — practical, not decorative.
distinguishing_marks: Ritual scarification along both temples in three parallel lines, each roughly 4cm long, faded to silvery-white — marks of commitment to the Congregation
Calloused palms and fingertips from handling cold metal conduits and pressure sensors
A faint burn scar on the right forearm (approximately 8cm), shaped like a partial arc — accidental contact with a steam vent during early Breathing sessions
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Any augmentation work would be subcutaneous or internal.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate slowness, as if perpetually listening. Stands with spine slightly curved, head tilted to one side. Breathes audibly and deeply, synchronizing their respiration with ambient pressure cycles. Gestures are minimal and measured.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 utilitarian ascetic. Layered linen and canvas in grays and earth tones, worn thin and patched. A long sleeveless overvest made from salvaged acoustic foam dampens echoes. No corporate branding. Feet wrapped in cloth rather than shoes — better tactile connection to the floor and its vibrations. A single cord belt holds a brass pressure gauge and small prayer beads carved from old plastic.
